clues.text: During Babylon's siege, officials lowered this prophet by ropes into a cistern with no water, only mud.
King Jehoiakim burned a scroll that Baruch the scribe had written down as this prophet dictated it.
Pashhur the priest had this prophet beaten and put in the stocks at the Upper Gate of Benjamin.
God told this prophet He knew him before forming him in the womb and appointed him to the nations.
When God asked this prophet what he saw, he answered figs: the good very good, the bad uneatable.
He bought his cousin Hanamel's field in Anathoth, weighing out seventeen shekels of silver.
Daniel read in the sacred books that God's word through this prophet set the desolation at seventy years.
